name: agentic-qa
description: Rule enforcement and test-contract verification for AI-written production code

scripts.prepare: npm run build && (node dist/cli.js install-hooks || true)
scripts.eval:rules: npm run build && cd fixtures/rules && node ../../dist/cli.js rules --expected expected.json
scripts.eval:rules-llm: npm run build && cd fixtures/rules-llm && node ../../dist/cli.js rules --llm --expected expected.json
scripts.eval:contracts: npm run build && cd fixtures/sample && node ../../dist/cli.js eval
